name: LingBot-Depth (Masked Depth Modeling)
description: Upstream mirror of Robbyant's LingBot-Depth: a ViT-L/14 masked-depth-modeling model that refines incomplete, noisy RGB-D sensor depth into metric-accurate depth maps and 3D point clouds. In the Notations Universe it is a perception primitive: given an RGB image, a raw depth map and camera intrinsics it proposes clean geometry for scan-to-BIM registration, scene reconstruction and downstream 3D engines. It is a library plus example CLI with no server; every run is a GPU compute job that downloads weights from Hugging Face. It must never be treated as canonical geometry: its outputs are model predictions to be registered as evidence, not as measured state.

capabilities.label: Run depth refinement example (example.py)
capabilities.description: `python example.py [--example N] [--model <hf-id|ckpt/model.pt>] [--output DIR] [--device auto|cuda|cpu] [--no-mask]`. Reads examples/<N>/{rgb.png|jpg, raw_depth.png (16-bit mm), intrinsics.txt}, loads the checkpoint (Hugging Face download on first run), runs MDMModel.infer and writes result/{depth_input.npy, depth_refined.npy (float32 m), depth_input.png, depth_refined.png, depth_comparison.png, rgb.png, point_cloud.ply}.
capabilities.side_effects: writes output dir; downloads model weights from huggingface.co

capabilities.label: Load MDMModel checkpoint (Python API)
capabilities.description: `mdm.model.v2.MDMModel.from_pretrained(name_or_path, model_kwargs=None, **hf_kwargs)`: loads a local model.pt or downloads `model.pt` from a Hugging Face model repo (robbyant/lingbot-depth-pretrain-vitl-14-v0.5 recommended; -v0.1; postrain-dc-vitl14 for sparse completion). Returns a torch.nn.Module to move to device.
capabilities.side_effects: network download of ~ViT-L weights via huggingface_hub

capabilities.label: Refine depth and lift to point cloud (MDMModel.infer)
capabilities.description: `model.infer(image[B,3,H,W] float 0-1, depth_in[B,H,W] metres (0=missing), num_tokens=None, resolution_level=9, apply_mask=True, use_fp16=True, intrinsics[B,3,3] normalised by W/H)` -> dict with `depth` [B,H,W] refined metric depth, `mask` [B,H,W] bool validity, and `points` [B,H,W,3] camera-space XYZ when intrinsics are given (masked pixels set to inf). Depth input is required in this version.

capabilities.label: Extract RGB-D latent features (MDMModel.infer_feat)
capabilities.description: Same inputs as infer; returns the encoder's joint RGB-depth feature tokens instead of decoded depth, for downstream representation learning (tracking, manipulation policies).

capabilities.label: RGB-D file I/O helpers (mdm.utils.io)
capabilities.description: read/write_image, read/write_depth (16-bit PNG), read/write_normal, read/write_mask, read/write_segmentation, read/write_json, save_ply and save_glb (trimesh) for exchanging inputs and predictions on disk.

capabilities.label: Unproject depth to points (mdm.utils.geo)
capabilities.description: `depth_to_pointcloud(depth, intrinsic_normalized, depth_scale=1.0)` unprojects a depth map with width/height-normalised intrinsics into camera-space XYZ; `normalized_view_plane_uv` builds the pixel ray grid.

capabilities.label: Colorize depth/normal/error maps (mdm.utils.vis)
capabilities.description: colorize_depth, colorize_depth_affine, colorize_disparity, colorize_normal, colorize_error_map produce uint8 RGB visualisations for dashboards and QA.

capabilities.label: Example scene input contract
capabilities.description: Eight bundled indoor scenes examples/0-7, each `rgb.png|jpg`, `raw_depth.png` (uint16 millimetres, 0 = missing) and `intrinsics.txt` (3x3 pixel-unit K). Any caller supplying this trio can be refined; intrinsics are normalised by image width/height before inference.

capabilities.label: MDM RGB-D training dataset (external)
capabilities.description: 3,019,200-sample RGB-D corpus (RobbyReal 1.4M real indoor captures, RobbyVla 581k robot-manipulation frames, RobbySim 999k renders, RobbySimVal 39k) published on Hugging Face `robbyant/mdm_depth` and ModelScope. Read-only reference of what the model was trained on; not mirrored in this repo.

relations.description: Inferred from naming and format, not from code: the refined point clouds LingBot-Depth writes (point_cloud.ply via trimesh) are the kind of PLY scan evidence the BIM state transformer's load_ply_points/ScanRegistrar consumes. Neither repository references the other.
relations.evidence: example.py (point_cloud.ply export); bim-state-transformer-engine catalog contract (PLY scan input)

contracts.name: infer output dict
contracts.summary: {depth: [B,H,W] m, mask: [B,H,W] bool, points: [B,H,W,3] camera XYZ (inf where masked)}

contracts.name: example result dir
contracts.summary: depth_input.npy, depth_refined.npy, depth_*.png, rgb.png, point_cloud.ply (colored, 2x downsampled)

resources.name: examples/
resources.description: 8 indoor RGB-D example scenes with intrinsics

external_services.name: Hugging Face Hub
external_services.purpose: model checkpoint download (hf_hub_download model.pt) and dataset hosting

reference.spatial: Camera-space metric geometry only (depth in metres, points relative to the sensor); no world coordinates or GIS.
reference.temporal: Single-frame inference; no time dimension beyond per-frame calls (4D tracking is a downstream use).
open_questions: Which ecosystem node will actually call LingBot-Depth (payload-render-engine, bim-state-transformer-engine, lichtfeld-studio)? No caller exists in code today.
Should the mirror pin a checkpoint hash so registered evidence is reproducible?
